title: Audit Inventory Adjustments in Inventory
description: Complete the audit inventory adjustments workflow in the Inventory module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with admin access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Inventory module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for audit inventory adjustments are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Inventory module from the main navigation.
Locate the audit inventory adjustments entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for audit inventory adjustments.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Audit Inventory Adjustments completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Inventory views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during audit inventory adjustments.
Permission constraints prevent completion of audit inventory adjustments.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun audit inventory adjustments.
Confirm role permissions for admin and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun audit inventory adjustments?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm audit inventory adjustments is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
